newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey in contact with Iran over Iraqi Kurds.
newsitem.headline: Turkey in contact with Iran over Iraqi Kurds.

text.p: Foreign Minister Tansu Ciller said on Tuesday Turkey was in contact with neighbouring Iran about its alleged backing for a Kurdish group embroiled in fighting in northern Iraq.
"We are in contact with Iran, dialogue is continuing," Ciller told reporters after meeting President Suleyman Demirel.
"We have received certain information along the lines of Iranians inside (Kurdistan Patriotic Union of Kurdistan leader Jalal) Talabani's forces," she said.

Massoud Barzani's Kurdistan Democratic Party (KDP) has accused Iran of sending troops, arms and ammunition into northern Iraq to help the PUK in fighting between the two groups. Tehran denies the charges.

Senior members of the KDP, which was helped by Iraqi troops during Kurdish fighting in August, met Turkish foreign ministry officials on Monday. The delegation later left for Washington for talks with U.S. officials on Wednesday.
